title: Bill seeking to translate Constitution to Filipino, Arabic refiled

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A bill seeking to make the 1987 Constitution more accessible through translations into Filipino, major regional languages, Arabic, and Spanish has been refiled in the Senate. Senate Bill No. 2600, or the proposed Constitutional Translation and Access Act, seeks to establish a framework to complete outstanding translations of the country’s fundamental law and make existing versions more widely available to the public. The measure was filed by Sen. Loren Legarda on Tuesday, who also pushed for similar legislation during the 16th and 17th Congresses.
